test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The old lady finds it difficult to climb the steep steps of the train and asked for help.
solution:
The erroneous segment in the sentence is **finds it .** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the improper use of parallelism is there .
 
• **Parallelism is the practice of lining up all your verb tenses when you have a list of them in one sentence.**
 
• When two or more **verbs** have the same subject the verbs must be **parallel.**
 
 
• In the above sentence , The old lady is the** only subject** for 2 verbs used in the sentence i.e.** finds **and **asked**. Both are indifferent **tenses** *finds* is in** V1** and *asked *is in **V2 **form.
 
 
 
• Therefore as per the rule of **conjunction** with **parallelism,** the above sentence should be in the **simple past tense **as in accordance with the verb **asked.** 
 
• The structure of **simple past tense**: **Subject + V2.**
 
• Hence, instead of **finds it** , we will use **found** to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• So, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
